instruction: Go directly to the pillow with a cloth nearby, passing through exactly one door on the way. From there, go directly to the vase farthest from the printer, and then go directly to the cabinet that is in the bedroom and has a couch nearby.

vias.label: pillow
vias.phrase: the pillow near at least one cloth

vias.name: v2

vias.phrase: the vase farthest from the printer
